topic.title: A Trading Journal Helps You Review Decisions, Not Predict Price

research.summary: Record the setup, the reason for entry, the invalidation point, the risk, and whether you followed your rules. Review a group of trades to look for repeated process errors. A small sample can be misleading, and a journal cannot remove uncertainty, but it can make your learning more structured.
